translations.web: For the day is near, even Yahweh’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
translations.bsb: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
translations.kjv: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
translations.asv: For the day is near, even the day of Jehovah is near; it shall be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.
